lines.text: Josiah became king at eight years old, reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem, and did what was right in the LORD's eyes.
In his eighteenth year, Josiah sent Shaphan to have the money counted so workers could buy timber and dressed stone.
Hilkiah the high priest told Shaphan he had found the ark of the covenant in the house of the LORD.
Josiah sent five men to ask the LORD about the book, and they went to Deborah the prophetess in Jerusalem.
Because Josiah's heart was tender and he humbled himself, the LORD said he would be gathered to his grave in peace.
